modifications: Original mlx2 implementations inspired by TensorFold prefill grouping and its native-MLX M5 path. No MLX upstream kernel source is copied, fetched or inlined.

Native backend packs qkv/z and dense gate/up weights once; the reference modules retain views of those arrays. Small GDN b/a projections retain reference reductions after full-model testing rejected four-way packing.
Generalized only the native grouped-QMM backend from affine q4/group-64 to validated affine q4 or q8/group-64 geometry. The custom M5 tiled Metal backend remains q4-only.
Permit Qwen4 shared-expert dense gate/up grouping while routed switch-expert tables remain excluded and adapter-owned varlen compaction retains the sparse-MoE boundary.

Original M5 Metal Performance Primitives 32x64x64 tiled q4/group-64 matrix kernel: threadgroup dequantization, masked row/output tails, fused optional biases. Separate fused gate/up/SwiGLU kernel writes only the final activation.
Bounded-segment orchestration of installed mx.fast.gated_delta_update, chunk-8/chunk-16 policy, nonzero state carry, and balanced tails. The dependency supplies the scan primitive.
Decode and speculative verification keep reference arithmetic. Each opt-in candidate has a stable qualification and APCv2 cache identity; default settings and receipts remain unchanged.
